thesis: Self-stylization can create identity and pleasure while compulsory aesthetic scrutiny narrows freedom.

ideas.statement: Autonomy depends on alternatives, refusal costs and revision, not the visible practice; dignity must survive outside aesthetic evaluation.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Objectification theory and social-media evidence do not diagnose every practice; acceptance can itself impose a performance of perfectly confident liberation.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Objectification theory and social-media evidence do not diagnose every practice; acceptance can itself impose a performance of perfectly confident liberation.

audit.notes: Direct active-LLM analysis; argument distinguished from established empirical result.
